title: Jubilant Nutty Venezuelan Brown Lentil Bowl
description: A hearty and energizing Venezuelan dish featuring brown lentils, with a nutty and crumbly texture, served in an earthenware bowl. This satvik-friendly recipe is perfect for a nutritious lunch.
instructions: In a large earthenware bowl, rinse the brown lentils and soak them in water for 30 minutes.
In a large pot, heat the peanut oil over medium heat and saute the chopped onion until softened.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the chopped carrots, cumin, coriander, and salt, and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the soaked and drained brown lentils, and the remaining 2 cups of water to the pot, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the pot, and simmer for 20 minutes, or until the lentils are tender.
While the lentils are cooking, toast the pumpkin seeds in a small skillet over medium heat, stirring frequently.
Once the lentils are cooked, stir in the toasted pumpkin seeds and season with additional salt if needed.
Serve the lentil mixture in the earthenware bowl, garnished with additional toasted pumpkin seeds if desired.
